name: Vona de Iedo
description: Infamous vampire conquistador of the Legion of Dusk and noble of Torrezon on Ixalan.

description_citations.text: "Vona de Iedo". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun and a current of energy rushes through them.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun.

citation.text: "Huatli", section "Search for the Immortal Sun". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Orazca Malcolm's song paralyzes the combatants over the Immortal Sun, letting Breeches stop Vona from killing Huatli.
timeline.quote: Malcolm used his song to paralyze Huatli , Tishana , Vona , and Mavren Fein

citation.text: "Malcolm Lee", section "Race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein overpower Kumena and throw him from the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: They quickly threw him out of the window of the Tower of Triumph.

citation.text: "Orazca", section "The race for Orazca". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona earns the name Butcher of Magan by slaughtering a dozen officers, including the general, and opening the gate.
timeline.quote: Vona earned her moniker by sneaking into the walled village at night

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "The Apostasine Wars". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Torrezon's victory, Vona slaughters her serfs and becomes a duelist.
timeline.quote: she slaughtered her own human serfs and abandoned her humble estate

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Conquest of the free cities". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona sails on the first ship to Ixalan and cuts a swath across it, seeking Elenda.
timeline.quote: Vona was on the first ship that left port

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona's agents fail to find the Temple of Aclazotz; Alante claims the chalice.
timeline.quote: her agents failed to locate the temple

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona steals the Thaumatic Compass from Vraska; Huatli and Tishana retrieve it.
timeline.quote: she managed to steal the Thaumatic Compass from Vraska

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: With Mavren Fein, Vona reaches Orazca and throws Kumena from the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: threw Kumena out of the window of the Tower of Triumph

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elenda reappears, tells followers they are free, and says she will become the sun's sentinel; Mavren Fein punishes Vona and the Legion leaves Ixalan.
timeline.quote: the Legion left the continent of Ixalan

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Ixalan". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At the Sanctum of the Sun she refuses Mavren Fein's request to retrieve the vanished Immortal Sun, tells the vampires they are free, and rebukes Vona.
timeline.quote: Elenda refused, telling the vampire that they were finally free from their ancient duty

citation.text: "Elenda of Garrano", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kumena reaches the Sanctum of the Sun but is bested by Vona and Mavren Fein and thrown out of the tower, then saved by Tishana.
timeline.quote: he was saved in time by his former teacher, Tishana

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Fight for Control". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: A brawl erupts in the chamber and everyone scrambles to touch the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: everyone scrambled to touch the Immortal Sun

citation.text: "Immortal Sun", section "The Fight for Control". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Elenda tells her followers that immortality was not the purpose of her gift but protection, and that she will be sentinel of the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Elenda answered that immortality was not the purpose of her gift, but protection.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mavren Fein punishes Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.
timeline.quote: Vona denied her, but Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The Age of Ever-Flowing Blood". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Mavren joins Vona and reaches Orazca, throwing Kumena out of the Tower of Triumph.
timeline.quote: threw Kumena out of the window of the Tower of Triumph

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Saint Elenda reappears and tells her followers they are free from their ancient duty; Mavren punishes Vona for speaking ill of her, and the Legion leaves Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Mavren Fein punished Vona for speaking ill of the living saint

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Invasion Fein is promoted to Pontifex but Vona breaks away to form a splinter church.
timeline.quote: Fein was promoted to Pontifex of the Church of Dusk

citation.text: "Mavren Fein", section "Aftermath of the Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Torrezon splits between orthodoxy under Mavren Fein and radicals under Vona.
timeline.quote: The church orthodoxy is directed by Pontifex Mavren Fein.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes on a Dusk Legion ship bound for Torrezon to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Legion of Dusk", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito boasts of making himself a saint and of ruling at Aclazotz's side with Vona.
timeline.quote: Together, Vona and I will rule at our master's side

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz singles out Vona de Iedo as the vampire he wants at his right wing.
timeline.quote: One vampire he craved above all others: Vona de Iedo, the Antifex.

citation.work: The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6
citation.text: "The Lost Caverns of Ixalan | Episode 6" by Valerie Valdes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Oct 2023.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Aclazotz", section "Freedom". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire builds a second Dawn Fleet and Admiral Beckett Brass crashes a meeting, agreeing to support both factions for a Coalition state.
timeline.quote: Admiral Beckett Brass crashed a meeting of the two factions

citation.text: "Ixalan (plane)", section "Rediscovery of the Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Aclazotz escapes on a Dusk Legion ship toward Torrezon, intending to find Vona.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz escaped, securing passage to Torrezon on a Dusk Legion ship.

citation.text: "Queen's Bay Company", section "To Ixalan's Core". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Church factions form behind Pontifex Mavren Fein and Antifex Vona de Iedo, with separatists opposing Queen Miralda.
timeline.quote: The radicals look to Antifex Vona de Iedo for guidance.

citation.text: "Torrezon", section "The crisis of faith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vito supports Vona de Iedo's schism and leads an expedition to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: Vito helped ignite a schism

citation.text: "Vito Quijano de Pasamonte", section "Freeing Aclazotz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Angry at Elenda's pacifism, Vona begins a schism calling herself the Antifex.
timeline.quote: began a schism within the Church of Dusk

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Antifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After Vito's death, Aclazotz identifies Vona as a prime candidate to be his champion.
timeline.quote: Aclazotz identified Vona as a prime candidate to be his champion

citation.text: "Vona de Iedo", section "Antifex". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Disillusioned with Queen Miralda's orders, Clavileño becomes a zealot for Vona de Iedo and sails to Ixalan.
timeline.quote: made Clavileño disillusioned with his monarch

citation.text: "Clavileño", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona joined the first fleet to Ixalan and established the Foothold as a stronghold for her own ambitions.
timeline.quote: Vona joined the first fleet to cross the sea to Ixalan .

citation.text: "Conqueror's Foothold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona discovered a map to the Hierophant's Chalice and used the Foothold and its prisoners to search for it.
timeline.quote: Vona discovered a map leading to the Hierophant's Chalice, an artifact said to create an endless supply of blood.

citation.text: "Conqueror's Foothold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Alante turned against Vona, stole the map, freed the prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz, securing the Chalice for her order.
timeline.quote: Stealing the map, she freed the doomed prisoners and led them to the Temple of Aclazotz ahead of Vona’s forces, ultimately securing the Chalice for her order and thwarting Vona’s plan.

citation.text: "Conqueror's Foothold", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vona and Mavren Fein cast Kumena from the Tower of Triumph to seize the Immortal Sun.
timeline.quote: Vona and Mavren Fein of the Legion of Dusk cast him from the Tower of Triumph

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Immortal Sun vanishes through Tezzeret's portal; Elenda refuses to help the Legion recover it.
timeline.quote: Elenda refused to aid the Legion in recovering it, declaring their ancient burden fulfilled at last.

citation.text: "Rediscovery of Orazca", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kellan and Amalia leave for Ravnica; Quint finds a preserved Coin Empire vessel; the Mycotyrant overruns Sunray Bay; Aclazotz seeks an alliance with Vona de Iedo.
timeline.quote: the Mycotyrant overran the coastal town of Sunray Bay

citation.text: "Reopening of Ixalan's Core", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
